lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: High-intensity white spots arranged in semi-regular vertical columns posterior to the pectoral fin attachment. Spatial distribution shows clusters forming roughly 4-5 distinguishable vertical rows on the mid-lateral flank.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Subtle vertical bands of elevated luminance intersect with the primary circular blobs, creating a faint rectilinear grid pattern in the central flank region.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Two distinct longitudinal ridges are visible on the upper third of the flank, characterized by a sharp light-to-shadow gradient running horizontally across the body.

other_distinctive_markers: A distinctive, non-linear 'hook' or 'swirl' pattern of high-luminance pixels is located on the upper flank, posterior to the gill region and dorsal to the primary grid constellation.
